# Master glossary

Every term from the Key-vocabulary tables of all 12 chapters and supplements, plus every acronym the site uses: 488 entries, merged and alphabetized. Each entry gives the 中文 term, a short meaning where one exists, and a link to the page it comes from. Tap any acronym on any page to jump here.

## 0–9 { #letter-digits }

### 3D flash { #term-3d-flash .sdd-term }

**三維閃存（台：3D 快閃記憶體）** — NAND built as vertical strings through a stack of wordline layers instead of on a flat surface. → [§3.1.5](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#315-3d-flash)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## A { #letter-a }

### A2H { #term-a2h .sdd-term }

address-to-hash table (XtremIO metadata)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ACK { #term-ack .sdd-term }

acknowledgment  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ACPI { #term-acpi .sdd-term }

Advanced Configuration and Power Interface (OS power-management standard)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ACTP { #term-actp .sdd-term }

Active Power (avg over 10-second window)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### addressing { #term-addressing .sdd-term }

**尋址（台：定址）** — Naming a location on the chip: LUN, block and page in the row address, byte offset in the column address. → [§3.2.4](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#324-addressing)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Admin command { #term-admin-command .sdd-term }

**管理命令（台：管理指令）** — A command that manages the drive (creating queues, Identify, features) rather than moving data. → [§6.2](../core/ch6-nvme.md#62-nvme-overview-the-command-model)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### AHCI { #term-ahci .sdd-term }

Advanced Host Controller Interface (the SATA-era host interface)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ALE { #term-ale .sdd-term }

Address Latch Enable (NAND pin)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### all-flash array (AFA) { #term-all-flash-array-afa .sdd-term }

**全閃存陣列（台：全快閃陣列）** — An enterprise storage system built only from SSDs, with software designed around flash. → [§2.6](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#26-all-flash-arrays-afa)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ALPM { #term-alpm .sdd-term }

Aggressive Link Power Management (SATA)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### amorphous / crystalline state { #term-amorphous-crystalline-state .sdd-term }

**無定形態 / 晶體態（台：非晶態 / 結晶態）** — PCM's high-resistance (disordered) and low-resistance (ordered) states. → [§3.1.7](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#317-3d-xpoint-and-the-emerging-memory-zoo)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### APB { #term-apb .sdd-term }

Advanced Peripheral Bus (Arm on-chip bus for slow peripherals)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### API { #term-api .sdd-term }

application programming interface  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### APST { #term-apst .sdd-term }

Autonomous Power State Transition (controller self-idles at NVMe layer)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ASIC { #term-asic .sdd-term }

application-specific integrated circuit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ASPM { #term-aspm .sdd-term }

Active State Power Management (hardware-autonomous link idling)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ATA { #term-ata .sdd-term }

AT Attachment (the disk command set behind SATA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### atomic operation { #term-atomic-operation .sdd-term }

**原子操作** — An operation that completes entirely or not at all, as shared-namespace access must. → [§6.7](../core/ch6-nvme.md#67-namespaces)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### AXI { #term-axi .sdd-term }

Advanced eXtensible Interface (Arm on-chip high-speed bus)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## B { #letter-b }

### bad block { #term-bad-block .sdd-term }

**壞塊（台：壞區塊）** — A block that can no longer hold data reliably, from the factory or from wear, and is retired. → [§3.3.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#331-the-five-problems-a-catalog-to-know-cold); A block the FTL has retired; it is recorded in the bad-block table and never written again. → [§4.7](../core/ch4-ftl.md#47-bad-block-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### bad block management { #term-bad-block-management .sdd-term }

**壞塊管理（台：壞區塊管理）** — Finding flash blocks that have failed and retiring them in favour of spares. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### bandwidth { #term-bandwidth .sdd-term }

**帶寬（台：頻寬）** — Data moved per second; for PCIe, quoted per direction or for both directions combined. → [§5.1](../core/ch5-pcie.md#51-starting-with-speed)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Base Address Register (BAR) { #term-base-address-register-bar .sdd-term }

**基地址寄存器（台：基底位址暫存器）** — A config register that holds where one of a device's memory regions appears in the host's address space. → [§5.6](../core/ch5-pcie.md#56-config-space-and-bars)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### BCH code { #term-bch-code .sdd-term }

**BCH碼** — An algebraic, cyclic code that corrects several errors per codeword from hard bits. → [§A.3.4](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a34-where-bch-fits)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### belief propagation / sum-product { #term-belief-propagation-sum-product .sdd-term }

**置信傳播 / 和積算法（台：信念傳遞 / 和積演算法）** — The soft-decision iterative decoder that passes LLR messages along the Tanner graph. → [§A.5.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a52-sum-product-belief-propagation-soft-decision)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### BGA { #term-bga .sdd-term }

ball grid array (a chip package soldered by balls underneath)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### BiCS { #term-bics .sdd-term }

Bit Cost Scalable (Kioxia / Western Digital 3D NAND architecture)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### BiCS8 { #term-bics8 .sdd-term }

BiCS generation 8 (218-layer 3D NAND)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### BIOS { #term-bios .sdd-term }

Basic Input/Output System (PC boot firmware)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### bit bucket { #term-bit-bucket .sdd-term }

**位桶（台：位元桶）** — An SGL descriptor that tells the SSD to discard that much of the read data instead of sending it. → [§6.4](../core/ch6-nvme.md#64-the-addressing-duo-prp-and-sgl)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### bit-flipping { #term-bit-flipping .sdd-term }

**比特翻轉（台：位元翻轉）** — A hard-decision iterative decoder that flips the bits sitting in the most failed checks. → [§A.5.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a51-bit-flipping-hard-decision)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### block / inode bitmap { #term-block-inode-bitmap .sdd-term }

free/used tracking in EXT4  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### block / page { #term-block-page .sdd-term }

**塊 / 頁（台：區塊 / 頁）** — The erase unit (all wordlines sharing one substrate) and the read/program unit (the cells along one wordline). → [§3.1.3](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#313-the-hierarchy-cell-page-block-plane-die)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### block / page / hybrid mapping { #term-block-page-hybrid-mapping .sdd-term }

**塊映射 / 頁映射 / 混合映射（台：區塊映射 / 頁映射 / 混合映射）** — Mapping granularities: whole blocks (small table, slow small writes), single pages (big table, fast), or a mix. → [§4.2.1](../core/ch4-ftl.md#421-mapping-granularity)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### block group { #term-block-group .sdd-term }

EXT4's fixed volume subdivision  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### BMC { #term-bmc .sdd-term }

baseboard management controller (a server's management chip)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### boot ROM / bootloader { #term-boot-rom-bootloader .sdd-term }

**啟動ROM / 引導程序（台：開機ROM / 開機載入程式）** — The fixed first code in the controller's silicon, and the next stage it loads from flash. → [§2.8.4](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#284-boot-rom-first-then-flash)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### boundary-value test { #term-boundary-value-test .sdd-term }

**邊界值測試** — Testing at the edges of allowed inputs, where bugs cluster. → [§7.4](../core/ch7-testing.md#74-regression-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### burst performance { #term-burst-performance .sdd-term }

**突發性能（台：突發效能）** — Write speed while the SLC cache lasts, as opposed to the sustained speed once it is full. → [§4.8](../core/ch4-ftl.md#48-slc-cache)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Bus/Device/Function (BDF) { #term-busdevicefunction-bdf .sdd-term }

**總線/設備/功能號（台：匯流排/裝置/功能編號）** — The address of one PCIe Function: up to 256 buses × 32 devices × 8 functions. → [§5.6](../core/ch5-pcie.md#56-config-space-and-bars)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## C { #letter-c }

### cache / buffer { #term-cache-buffer .sdd-term }

**緩存（台：快取）** — Fast memory on the drive (DRAM or SRAM) that holds the map table and stages data in flight. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### cache register / page register { #term-cache-register-page-register .sdd-term }

**緩存寄存器 / 頁寄存器（台：快取暫存器 / 頁暫存器）** — A plane's two page-sized buffers, which let a bus transfer overlap an array access. → [§3.1.3](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#313-the-hierarchy-cell-page-block-plane-die)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### capacity { #term-capacity .sdd-term }

**容量** — The user-visible size of the drive, quoted in decimal units (1 GB = 10⁹ bytes). → [§1.5.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#151-basic-information)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### cascade / scale-out { #term-cascade-scale-out .sdd-term }

**級聯（台：串接）** — Growing one system by adding units (X-Bricks), so capacity and performance rise together. → [§2.6.2](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#262-hardware-architecture)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CBA { #term-cba .sdd-term }

CMOS directly Bonded to Array (logic wafer bonded onto the cell-array wafer)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### CCTEMP { #term-cctemp .sdd-term }

Critical Composite Temperature Threshold (NVMe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### CE { #term-ce .sdd-term }

Chip Enable (NAND pin that selects one die on a shared channel)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### certification { #term-certification .sdd-term }

**認證** — Passing an industry body's tests, such as PCI-SIG's or UNH-IOL's, to join its Integrators List. → [§7.9](../core/ch7-testing.md#79-certification)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CfgWr { #term-cfgwr .sdd-term }

Configuration Write request (PCIe TLP)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### channel { #term-channel .sdd-term }

**通道** — One shared bus from the flash controller to a group of dies; separate channels work in parallel. → [§2.1.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#213-back-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### channel (transistor) { #term-channel-transistor .sdd-term }

**溝道（台：通道）** — The strip of silicon under the gate that conducts when the cell is switched on. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### charge leakage { #term-charge-leakage .sdd-term }

**電荷泄漏（台：電荷洩漏）** — Stored electrons slowly escaping through the oxide, the cause of retention errors. → [§3.3.6](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#336-data-retention-how-long-does-data-survive)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### charge trap (CT) { #term-charge-trap-ct .sdd-term }

**電阱 / 電荷捕捉** — A cell design that stores electrons in traps in an insulating nitride layer instead of a conducting floating gate. → [§3.1.6](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#316-charge-trap-flash-the-other-way-to-hold-an-electron)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### check node (CN) { #term-check-node-cn .sdd-term }

**校驗節點（台：檢查節點）** — A Tanner-graph node for one parity equation, a row of H. → [§A.4.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a42-the-tanner-graph)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### checkpoint (CP) { #term-checkpoint-cp .sdd-term }

F2FS consistent snapshot (power-loss recovery)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CLE { #term-cle .sdd-term }

Command Latch Enable (NAND pin)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### cleaning { #term-cleaning .sdd-term }

F2FS garbage collection (greedy / cost-benefit victim; ≈ SSD GC, Ch4)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CLKREQ# { #term-clkreq .sdd-term }

PCIe sideband pin gating deep link states (≈ SATA DEVSLP)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CMOS { #term-cmos .sdd-term }

complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor (standard logic process)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### code rate R = k/n { #term-code-rate-r-kn .sdd-term }

**碼率（台：編碼率）** — The fraction of a codeword that is data; a higher rate means less overhead and weaker protection. → [§A.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a2-the-communication-system-model)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### codeword { #term-codeword .sdd-term }

**碼字** — The n bits the encoder produces from k data bits: the data plus its parity. → [§A.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a2-the-communication-system-model)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### cold data / hot data { #term-cold-data-hot-data .sdd-term }

**冷數據 / 熱數據（台：冷資料 / 熱資料）** — Data rarely updated versus data rewritten often; mixing the two in one block causes needless GC. → [§4.5](../core/ch4-ftl.md#45-wear-leveling)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### command decode/parsing { #term-command-decodeparsing .sdd-term }

**命令解析（台：指令解析）** — Turning a host command into what the FTL needs: read or write, start address, length and flags. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### command set { #term-command-set .sdd-term }

**命令集（台：指令集）** — A family of NVMe I/O commands for one kind of storage: NVM (block), Zoned, Key-Value. → [§6.9](../core/ch6-nvme.md#69-modern-developments-the-nvme-2x-era)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### compatibility { #term-compatibility .sdd-term }

**兼容性（台：相容性）** — Working correctly with every host, BIOS, OS and signal condition the drive meets. → [§1.5.6](../core/ch1-overview.md#156-system-compatibility)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Completion Queue (CQ) { #term-completion-queue-cq .sdd-term }

**完成隊列（台：完成佇列）** — A ring in host memory where the SSD posts 16-byte results. → [§6.2](../core/ch6-nvme.md#62-nvme-overview-the-command-model)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### compression { #term-compression .sdd-term }

**壓縮** — Encoding data in fewer bytes before it is stored. → [§2.6.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#263-software-architecture-the-real-value)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### computational storage { #term-computational-storage .sdd-term }

**帶計算功能的存儲（台：運算型儲存）** — Putting processing, such as an FPGA, inside the drive so that only results travel to the host. → [§2.7](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#27-computational-storage-ssds-that-compute)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### configuration space { #term-configuration-space .sdd-term }

**配置空間（台：組態空間）** — The standard register file of every Function, 4 KB in PCIe, holding IDs, capabilities and BARs. → [§5.6](../core/ch5-pcie.md#56-config-space-and-bars)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### conformance/compliance test { #term-conformancecompliance-test .sdd-term }

**一致性測試（台：符合性測試）** — Testing a product against the specification itself. → [§7.6](../core/ch7-testing.md#76-pcie-interop)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### consumer-grade / enterprise-grade { #term-consumer-grade-enterprise-grade .sdd-term }

**消費級 / 企業級** — Drive classes that differ in endurance, QoS and power-loss protection, and in how their specs are quoted. → [§1.5.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#152-performance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### control gate / substrate { #term-control-gate-substrate .sdd-term }

**控制極 / 襯底（台：控制閘極 / 基板）** — The gate a read or program voltage is applied to, and the silicon body beneath the cells, which erase acts through. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Controller Memory Buffer (CMB) { #term-controller-memory-buffer-cmb .sdd-term }

**控制器內存緩衝區（台：控制器記憶體緩衝區）** — Memory on the SSD exposed through a BAR, where the host can place queues or data. → [§6.10.2](../core/ch6-nvme.md#6102-cmb-the-mirror-image-of-hmb)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### copy-and-compaction / threaded logging { #term-copy-and-compaction-threaded-logging .sdd-term }

F2FS's two write schemes  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### correction capability t { #term-correction-capability-t .sdd-term }

**糾錯能力（台：錯誤更正能力）** — How many bit errors per codeword a code can always fix: t = ⌊(dmin − 1)/2⌋. → [§A.3.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a31-hamming-distance-the-concept-everything-rests-on)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### COTS { #term-cots .sdd-term }

Commercial Off-The-Shelf parts  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### coupling capacitance { #term-coupling-capacitance .sdd-term }

**耦合電容** — The capacitance between neighbouring cells that lets one cell's charge shift another's threshold. → [§3.3.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#331-the-five-problems-a-catalog-to-know-cold)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### CplD { #term-cpld .sdd-term }

Completion with Data (PCIe TLP)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### CPU { #term-cpu .sdd-term }

central processing unit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### CSEE { #term-csee .sdd-term }

Catastrophic SEE (the destructive subset)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### cyclic redundancy check (CRC) { #term-cyclic-redundancy-check-crc .sdd-term }

**循環冗餘校驗（台：循環冗餘檢查）** — A checksum that detects corrupted data; PI's guard field is a 16-bit CRC. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## D { #letter-d }

### D0 / D1 / D2 / D3hot / D3cold { #term-d0-d1-d2-d3hot-d3cold .sdd-term }

PCIe **device** power states (software-controlled)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### DAE (disk array enclosure) { #term-dae-disk-array-enclosure .sdd-term }

**磁盤陣列存儲櫃（台：磁碟陣列機箱）** — The shelf of drives in an array, cabled to both storage controllers. → [§2.6.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#261-the-anatomy)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Data Link Layer { #term-data-link-layer .sdd-term }

**數據鏈路層（台：資料連結層）** — The middle layer: sequence numbers, LCRC, ACK/NAK retry and credits, hop by hop. → [§5.8](../core/ch5-pcie.md#58-data-link-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Data Link Layer Packet (DLLP) { #term-data-link-layer-packet-dllp .sdd-term }

**數據鏈路層數據包（台：資料連結層封包）** — A small one-hop packet for acknowledgments, flow-control credits and power management. → [§5.8](../core/ch5-pcie.md#58-data-link-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### data randomization / scrambling { #term-data-randomization-scrambling .sdd-term }

**數據隨機化 / 擾碼（台：資料隨機化 / 擾碼）** — Scrambling data before it is written, so the stored bits stay near half ones and half zeros. → [§3.4.5](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#345-data-randomization)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### data retention { #term-data-retention .sdd-term }

**數據保存期（台：資料保存期）；數據保持（台：資料保存）** — How long written data stays readable before leakage creates more errors than ECC can fix. → [§3.3.6](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#336-data-retention-how-long-does-data-survive); Keeping data readable while unpowered; JESD218 checks it after the endurance writes. → [§7.8](../core/ch7-testing.md#78-endurance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### data verification { #term-data-verification .sdd-term }

**數據校驗（台：資料驗證）** — Writing known data, reading it back and comparing (R/W/C) to catch corruption. → [§7.1.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#711-fio-the-king-of-performance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### deduplication { #term-deduplication .sdd-term }

**去重（台：重複資料刪除）** — Storing identical blocks once and pointing every copy at the single stored block. → [§2.6.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#263-software-architecture-the-real-value)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### delayed allocation { #term-delayed-allocation .sdd-term }

allocate blocks at flush time, not write time  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### descriptor { #term-descriptor .sdd-term }

**描述符（台：描述元）** — One 16-byte entry of an SGL: a data block, a pointer to the next segment, or a bit bucket. → [§6.4](../core/ch6-nvme.md#64-the-addressing-duo-prp-and-sgl)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Descriptor / Attribute / Flag { #term-descriptor-attribute-flag .sdd-term }

**描述符 / 屬性 / 標誌（台：描述元 / 屬性 / 旗標）** — The three kinds of device configuration data, read and written with Query UPIUs. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### DETO { #term-deto .sdd-term }

DevSleep Exit Timeout (SATA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### DEVSLP { #term-devslp .sdd-term }

SATA deep-sleep pin (Ch1/Ch7)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### differential signaling { #term-differential-signaling .sdd-term }

**差分信號（台：差動訊號）** — Sending each bit as the difference between two wires, so noise that hits both cancels out. → [§5.9](../core/ch5-pcie.md#59-physical-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### direct memory access (DMA) { #term-direct-memory-access-dma .sdd-term }

**直接內存訪問（台：直接記憶體存取）** — Hardware that copies data between memory and a device without a processor moving each byte. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### discovery service { #term-discovery-service .sdd-term }

**發現服務（台：探索服務）** — An NVMe-oF service whose log page tells hosts which subsystems and paths exist. → [§6.8](../core/ch6-nvme.md#68-nvme-over-fabrics)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### DMAC { #term-dmac .sdd-term }

DMA controller  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### doorbell register (DB) { #term-doorbell-register-db .sdd-term }

**門鈴寄存器（台：門鈴暫存器）** — A register on the SSD that the host writes to announce new commands or consumed completions. → [§6.2](../core/ch6-nvme.md#62-nvme-overview-the-command-model)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### DQS { #term-dqs .sdd-term }

data strobe (NAND / DRAM timing signal)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### DR { #term-dr .sdd-term }

data retention  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### DRAM { #term-dram .sdd-term }

dynamic random-access memory  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### dual port { #term-dual-port .sdd-term }

**雙端口（台：雙埠）** — Two independent PCIe ports on one drive, so a second path survives the loss of the first. → [§6.7](../core/ch6-nvme.md#67-namespaces)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### dual-simplex / full-duplex / half-duplex { #term-dual-simplex-full-duplex-half-duplex .sdd-term }

**雙單工 / 全雙工 / 半雙工** — Both directions at once on separate wires (PCIe), both at once in general, or one direction at a time (SATA). → [§5.1](../core/ch5-pcie.md#51-starting-with-speed)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### DW { #term-dw .sdd-term }

doubleword (4 bytes)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### DWPD { #term-dwpd .sdd-term }

drive writes per day (endurance rating)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### dynamic / static wear leveling { #term-dynamic-static-wear-leveling .sdd-term }

**動態/靜態磨損平衡（台：動態/靜態平均抹寫）** — Placing new, hot writes on young blocks, versus deliberately moving cold data onto worn blocks. → [§4.5](../core/ch4-ftl.md#45-wear-leveling)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### dynamic power management { #term-dynamic-power-management .sdd-term }

host changes power state on the fly  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## E { #letter-e }

### ECRC { #term-ecrc .sdd-term }

end-to-end CRC (optional PCIe TLP digest)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### EDAC / scrubbing { #term-edac-scrubbing .sdd-term }

Error Detection And Correction; periodic read-correct-rewrite (≈ Read Scrub, Ch3)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### EDSFF { #term-edsff .sdd-term }

Enterprise and Data Center Standard Form Factor (E1 / E3 drives)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### embedded MultiMediaCard (eMMC) { #term-embedded-multimediacard-emmc .sdd-term }

**嵌入式多媒體卡** — UFS's predecessor: a parallel, half-duplex bus with no real command queuing. → [§B.1](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b1-what-ufs-is-the-emmc-successor)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### EMI { #term-emi .sdd-term }

electromagnetic interference  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### empty (fresh) drive / full drive { #term-empty-fresh-drive-full-drive .sdd-term }

**空盤 / 滿盤（台：空碟 / 滿碟）** — Performance measured fresh out of the box versus at steady state, after the drive has been filled. → [§1.5.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#152-performance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### enable signal / select signal { #term-enable-signal-select-signal .sdd-term }

**使能信號 / 選通信號（台：致能訊號 / 選通訊號）** — Control pins such as chip enable (CE#), which picks the die that listens on a shared channel. → [§2.1.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#213-back-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### encode / decode { #term-encode-decode .sdd-term }

**編碼 / 解碼** — Adding ECC parity to data on its way into flash, and using it to find and fix errors on the way out. → [§2.1.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#213-back-end); Turning data into line codes such as 8b/10b or 128b/130b, which embed the clock, and back again. → [§5.9](../core/ch5-pcie.md#59-physical-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### end-to-end data protection { #term-end-to-end-data-protection .sdd-term }

**端到端數據保護（台：端對端資料保護）** — Checking each block at every hop from host memory to flash and back. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### endpoint { #term-endpoint .sdd-term }

**端點 (Endpoint)** — A leaf device, such as an SSD or network card, that implements one or more Functions. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### endurance / lifespan { #term-endurance-lifespan .sdd-term }

**壽命** — How much data a drive can write before it wears out, stated as TBW or DWPD. → [§1.5.3](../core/ch1-overview.md#153-endurance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### endurance test { #term-endurance-test .sdd-term }

**耐久度測試** — Writing a drive to its rated TBW and then checking that it still retains data. → [§7.8](../core/ch7-testing.md#78-endurance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### enumeration { #term-enumeration .sdd-term }

**枚舉（台：列舉）** — The boot-time walk of the tree that finds every Function, sizes its BARs and assigns addresses. → [§5.6](../core/ch5-pcie.md#56-config-space-and-bars)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### EP { #term-ep .sdd-term }

endpoint (a PCIe device at a leaf of the tree)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### erase / write (program) / read { #term-erase-write-program-read .sdd-term }

**擦除 / 寫入(編程) / 讀取（台：抹除 / 寫入 / 讀取）** — The three flash operations: erase works on whole blocks, program and read on pages. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### erase count (EC) { #term-erase-count-ec .sdd-term }

**擦除次數（台：抹除次數）** — How many times a block has been erased, tracked per block to drive wear leveling. → [§4.5](../core/ch4-ftl.md#45-wear-leveling)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### error handling { #term-error-handling .sdd-term }

**錯誤處理** — The firmware and hardware paths that detect errors and recover from them. → [§7.3.3](../core/ch7-testing.md#733-jammer)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### error-correcting code (ECC) { #term-error-correcting-code-ecc .sdd-term }

**糾錯碼（台：錯誤更正碼）** — Redundant bits stored with the data that let the controller detect and correct bit errors; SSDs use the BCH and LDPC families. → [§2.1.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#213-back-end); Redundant bits stored with the data that let the controller detect and correct bit errors; SSDs use the BCH and LDPC families. → [§3.4.3](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#343-ecc-error-correcting-codes)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### error-locator polynomial { #term-error-locator-polynomial .sdd-term }

**錯誤位置多項式** — In BCH decoding, the polynomial built from the syndrome whose roots give the error positions. → [§A.3.4](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a34-where-bch-fits)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### exclusive OR (XOR) { #term-exclusive-or-xor .sdd-term }

**異或（台：互斥或）** — The bitwise operation RAID parity uses: XOR-ing the survivors of a stripe rebuilds the missing member. → [§3.4.4](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#344-raid-inside-the-ssd)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### EXT4 { #term-ext4 .sdd-term }

fourth extended filesystem (Linux)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### extent { #term-extent .sdd-term }

contiguous block range (start, start, length) — EXT4 range mapping  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## F { #letter-f }

### F2FS { #term-f2fs .sdd-term }

Flash-Friendly File System (flash-native LFS)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### factory / grown bad block { #term-factory-grown-bad-block .sdd-term }

**出廠/增長壞塊（台：出廠/增長壞區塊）** — Bad from manufacture and marked by the vendor, versus failing in service through an erase, program or uncorrectable read failure. → [§4.7](../core/ch4-ftl.md#47-bad-block-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FC { #term-fc .sdd-term }

Fibre Channel  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### FEC { #term-fec .sdd-term }

forward error correction  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### fetch (a command) { #term-fetch-a-command .sdd-term }

**取指（台：指令擷取）** — The SSD reading a command out of the host's submission queue with a PCIe Memory Read. → [§6.5](../core/ch6-nvme.md#65-trace-analysis-a-real-read-as-pcie-packets)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FFR { #term-ffr .sdd-term }

functional failure requirement (JEDEC endurance metric)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### filesystem { #term-filesystem .sdd-term }

OS layer mapping files onto a block device  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FIO { #term-fio .sdd-term }

Flexible I/O tester (Linux benchmark tool)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### firmware { #term-firmware .sdd-term }

**固件（台：韌體）** — The code running on the controller: command handling, the FTL and error recovery. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FIS (Frame Information Structure) { #term-fis-frame-information-structure .sdd-term }

**幀信息結構（台：訊框資訊結構）** — SATA's packet: commands, DMA setup, data and status all travel as FISes. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### flash chips (colloquial: "grains") { #term-flash-chips-colloquial-grains .sdd-term }

**顆粒** — Packaged NAND dies; 顆粒 is the industry's everyday word for them. → [§1.7](../core/ch1-overview.md#17-the-solid-state-storage-market)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### flash controller { #term-flash-controller .sdd-term }

**閃存控制器（台：快閃記憶體控制器）** — The back-end block that issues ONFI or Toggle commands to the NAND and moves data over the channels. → [§2.1.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#213-back-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### flash memory (NAND) { #term-flash-memory-nand .sdd-term }

**閃存（台：快閃記憶體）** — Non-volatile semiconductor memory that stores bits as trapped charge and must be erased before it is rewritten. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is); Non-volatile memory whose cells sit in series strings; it is erased a block at a time and programmed a page at a time. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Flash Translation Layer (FTL) { #term-flash-translation-layer-ftl .sdd-term }

**閃存轉換層（台：快閃記憶體轉換層）** — The drive's firmware that maps logical addresses to flash pages and runs garbage collection, wear leveling and recovery. → [§4.1](../core/ch4-ftl.md#41-ftl-overview)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Flexible Data Placement (FDP) { #term-flexible-data-placement-fdp .sdd-term }

**靈活數據放置（台：彈性資料放置）** — NVMe hints that steer related writes into shared reclaim units, cutting WA while the drive keeps its FTL. → [§4.11](../core/ch4-ftl.md#fdp-flexible-data-placement-nvme-tp4146)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FLIT { #term-flit .sdd-term }

flow control unit (PCIe 6.0's fixed-size transfer unit)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### floating gate { #term-floating-gate .sdd-term }

**浮柵（台：浮動閘極）** — A conducting layer, isolated by oxides, whose trapped electrons set the cell's threshold voltage. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### flow control { #term-flow-control .sdd-term }

**流控（台：流量控制）；流量控制 / 流控** — A receiver holding off a sender until it has room, as an SSD does by withholding SATA's DMA Setup FIS. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end); A receiver advertising credits for its free buffer space, so the sender never overruns it. → [§5.8](../core/ch5-pcie.md#58-data-link-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FLR { #term-flr .sdd-term }

Function Level Reset (PCIe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### foreground / background GC { #term-foreground-background-gc .sdd-term }

**前臺/後臺垃圾回收（台：前景/背景垃圾回收）** — GC forced into the write path when free blocks run out, versus GC done ahead of time in idle periods. → [§4.3.4](../core/ch4-ftl.md#434-when-gc-runs)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FPDMA { #term-fpdma .sdd-term }

First-Party DMA (SATA queued transfers)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### FPGA { #term-fpga .sdd-term }

field-programmable gate array  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### fresh out of box (FOB) { #term-fresh-out-of-box-fob .sdd-term }

**全新盤（台：全新碟）** — A new, empty drive, whose numbers are higher than it can sustain. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### front end / back end { #term-front-end-back-end .sdd-term }

**前端 / 後端** — The controller's host-facing half (protocol, command decode, DMA) and its flash-facing half (ECC, flash interface). → [§2.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#21-ssd-system-architecture)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### FUA { #term-fua .sdd-term }

Force Unit Access (the write must reach non-volatile media before it completes)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## G { #letter-g }

### garbage collection (GC) { #term-garbage-collection-gc .sdd-term }

**垃圾回收** — Copying the still-valid pages out of mostly-invalid blocks so those blocks can be erased and reused. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works); Reclaiming space: pick victim blocks, copy their valid pages elsewhere, then erase them. → [§4.3.3](../core/ch4-ftl.md#433-gc-implementation-three-steps)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### GCR { #term-gcr .sdd-term }

Galactic Cosmic Rays (high-energy interstellar particles)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### generator matrix G { #term-generator-matrix-g .sdd-term }

**生成矩陣** — The k × n matrix that encodes: c = u·G. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### GF(2) { #term-gf2 .sdd-term }

**二元域（台：二元有限體）** — The two-element Galois field, where addition is XOR and multiplication is AND. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### GMR { #term-gmr .sdd-term }

giant magnetoresistance (HDD read heads)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### GPIO { #term-gpio .sdd-term }

general-purpose input/output (pins)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### GPU { #term-gpu .sdd-term }

graphics processing unit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### GT { #term-gt .sdd-term }

gigatransfers (GT/s = billions of transfers per second)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### GUI { #term-gui .sdd-term }

graphical user interface  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## H { #letter-h }

### H2P { #term-h2p .sdd-term }

hash-to-physical table (XtremIO metadata)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### Hamming code { #term-hamming-code .sdd-term }

**漢明碼** — The single-error-correcting code family; Hamming(7,4) protects 4 data bits with 3 parity bits. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Hamming distance { #term-hamming-distance .sdd-term }

**漢明距離** — The number of positions in which two words differ. → [§A.3.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a31-hamming-distance-the-concept-everything-rests-on)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### hard / soft decision read { #term-hard-soft-decision-read .sdd-term }

**硬判決 / 軟判決讀取（台：硬式決策 / 軟式決策讀取）** — One sensing that yields bits only, versus several strobes that also yield each bit's confidence. → [§A.7](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a7-the-ldpc-codec-inside-the-ssd)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### hard disk drive (HDD) { #term-hard-disk-drive-hdd .sdd-term }

**機械硬盤（台：傳統硬碟）** — A drive that stores data magnetically on spinning platters, read by a moving head. → [§1.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#12-ssd-vs-hdd)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### hardware acceleration module { #term-hardware-acceleration-module .sdd-term }

**硬件加速模塊（台：硬體加速模組）** — Logic that runs a hot firmware path, such as map lookups, in hardware so the processor is free for other work. → [§2.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#23-case-study-silicongo-sg9081-anatomy-of-a-fast-sata-controller)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### HBA { #term-hba .sdd-term }

host bus adapter  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### HCTM { #term-hctm .sdd-term }

Host Controlled Thermal Management (NVMe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### head / tail { #term-head-tail .sdd-term }

**頭部 / 尾部** — The slot the consumer reads next, and the slot the producer writes next. → [§6.3](../core/ch6-nvme.md#63-the-three-treasures-in-detail)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### HIBERN8 { #term-hibern8 .sdd-term }

**休眠狀態** — M-PHY's deep low-power link state, UFS's counterpart of DevSleep. → [§B.6](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b6-ufs-low-power)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### host interface { #term-host-interface .sdd-term }

**主機接口（台：主機介面）** — The link to the computer and the protocol spoken over it: SATA, SAS, or PCIe with NVMe. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Host Memory Buffer (HMB) { #term-host-memory-buffer-hmb .sdd-term }

**主機內存緩衝區（台：主機記憶體緩衝區）** — An NVMe feature that lets a drive borrow a slice of host RAM for its map table. → [§4.2.3](../core/ch4-ftl.md#423-hmb-host-memory-buffer)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Host Performance Booster (HPB) { #term-host-performance-booster-hpb .sdd-term }

**主機性能加速（台：主機效能加速）** — The host caches slices of the device's L2P map and sends the physical address with each read. → [§B.8](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b8-hpb-host-performance-booster)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### host-based / device-based { #term-host-based-device-based .sdd-term }

**主機端 / 設備端（台：主機端 / 裝置端）** — An FTL run by software on the host, versus one run by the drive's own controller. → [§4.10](../core/ch4-ftl.md#410-host-based-ftl)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### host-initiated defragmentation { #term-host-initiated-defragmentation .sdd-term }

**主機發起的碎片整理（台：主機啟動的磁碟重組）** — UFS 4.1's host-scheduled clean-up of scattered data to restore read speed. → [§B.9](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b9-modern-developments-ufs-41-and-50)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### hot / warm / cold data { #term-hot-warm-cold-data .sdd-term }

**熱/溫/冷數據（台：熱/溫/冷資料）** — Data classified by how often it is accessed, so it can be placed on the right storage tier. → [§1.7](../core/ch1-overview.md#17-the-solid-state-storage-market)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### hot-plug { #term-hot-plug .sdd-term }

**熱插拔** — Inserting or removing a drive while the system runs, as U.2 and EDSFF bays allow. → [§5.12](../core/ch5-pcie.md#512-pcie-ssd-hot-plug)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### HS-Gear (G1–G6) { #term-hs-gear-g1g6 .sdd-term }

**高速檔位** — M-PHY's speed grades, the counterpart of PCIe generations; HS-G6 moves to PAM4. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## I { #letter-i }

### IEEE { #term-ieee .sdd-term }

Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### implicit routing { #term-implicit-routing .sdd-term }

**隱式路由（台：隱含路由）** — Routing used by messages that just mean "to the Root Complex" or "to everyone". → [§5.7](../core/ch5-pcie.md#57-tlp-routing)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### in-band { #term-in-band .sdd-term }

**帶內（台：頻內）** — Carried as packets over the data link itself rather than on separate wires. → [§5.4](../core/ch5-pcie.md#54-tlp-types)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### independent plane read (IPR / AIPR) { #term-independent-plane-read-ipr-aipr .sdd-term }

**獨立平面讀取** — Each plane running its own read at its own address and time, which makes the plane the unit of read parallelism. → [§3.5.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#351-independent-plane-operations-ipr-aipr)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### indirect blocks { #term-indirect-blocks .sdd-term }

ext2/3 per-block pointer scheme (fine-grained mapping)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Inline Hashing { #term-inline-hashing .sdd-term }

**內聯哈希（台：內嵌雜湊）** — UFS 5.0's on-the-fly hardware hashing of data for integrity checking. → [§B.9](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b9-modern-developments-ufs-41-and-50)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### inode { #term-inode .sdd-term }

fixed-size per-file metadata record (attrs + block pointers)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### interface / connector { #term-interface-connector .sdd-term }

**接口（台：介面）** — The physical and electrical link to the host: SATA, SAS or PCIe. → [§1.6](../core/ch1-overview.md#16-form-factors)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### interoperability test { #term-interoperability-test .sdd-term }

**交互性測試（台：互通性測試）** — Testing a product against other vendors' products. → [§7.6](../core/ch7-testing.md#76-pcie-interop)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### interrupt { #term-interrupt .sdd-term }

**中斷** — The SSD's signal that completions are waiting; in NVMe it is an MSI-X message, itself a memory write. → [§6.5](../core/ch6-nvme.md#65-trace-analysis-a-real-read-as-pcie-packets)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### IO { #term-io .sdd-term }

input/output  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### IOPS { #term-iops .sdd-term }

input/output operations per second  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### iSCSI { #term-iscsi .sdd-term }

Internet SCSI (SCSI carried over IP networks)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## J { #letter-j }

### JEDEC { #term-jedec .sdd-term }

JEDEC Solid State Technology Association (memory standards body)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### journaling { #term-journaling .sdd-term }

write intentions durably before applying (crash consistency)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### JTAG { #term-jtag .sdd-term }

Joint Test Action Group (the standard chip debug and test port)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## K { #letter-k }

### KV { #term-kv .sdd-term }

key-value  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## L { #letter-l }

### L0 / L0s / L1 / L2 / L3 { #term-l0-l0s-l1-l2-l3 .sdd-term }

PCIe **link** power states (active → off)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### L1.1 / L1.2 { #term-l11-l12 .sdd-term }

L1 substates (partial / full link shutdown)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### lane { #term-lane .sdd-term }

**通道 (Lane)** — One transmit pair plus one receive pair; links bundle lanes (×1, ×4, ×16) to add bandwidth. → [§5.1](../core/ch5-pcie.md#51-starting-with-speed)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### latency / response time { #term-latency-response-time .sdd-term }

**時延 / 響應時間（台：延遲 / 回應時間）** — The time from a command's arrival to its completion status. → [§1.5.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#152-performance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### layered structure { #term-layered-structure .sdd-term }

**分層結構** — Splitting the protocol into layers that each wrap the one above: transaction, data link, physical. → [§5.3](../core/ch5-pcie.md#53-the-three-layer-stack)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### LCRC { #term-lcrc .sdd-term }

link CRC (PCIe Data Link Layer checksum)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### LDO { #term-ldo .sdd-term }

low-dropout regulator (a small linear voltage regulator)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### LEO / MEO / GEO { #term-leo-meo-geo .sdd-term }

low / medium / geosynchronous orbit (rising radiation)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### LET { #term-let .sdd-term }

Linear Energy Transfer — particle energy deposition; sets upset threshold  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### LFS { #term-lfs .sdd-term }

log-structured file system (append-only writes)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### link { #term-link .sdd-term }

**鏈路 (Link)（台：連結）** — The connection between two PCIe ports, made of one or more lanes. → [§5.1](../core/ch5-pcie.md#51-starting-with-speed)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### log-likelihood ratio (LLR) { #term-log-likelihood-ratio-llr .sdd-term }

**對數似然比（台：對數概似比）** — log P(bit = 0) / P(bit = 1) given the reading: the sign is the best guess, the size is the confidence. → [§A.5.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a52-sum-product-belief-propagation-soft-decision)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### log-on-log { #term-log-on-log .sdd-term }

inefficiency of a log-structured FS atop a log-structured FTL  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logic analyzer { #term-logic-analyzer .sdd-term }

**邏輯分析儀** — An instrument that captures many digital signals over time for debugging. → [§7.3.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#731-emulator-vs-fpga)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logical / physical address { #term-logical-physical-address .sdd-term }

**邏輯地址 / 物理地址（台：邏輯位址 / 實體位址）** — The address the host uses, and the place in flash where the data actually sits. → [§4.1](../core/ch4-ftl.md#41-ftl-overview)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logical block address (LBA) { #term-logical-block-address-lba .sdd-term }

**邏輯塊地址（台：邏輯區塊位址）** — The address of one logical block within a namespace. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logical page / physical page { #term-logical-page-physical-page .sdd-term }

**邏輯頁 / 物理頁（台：邏輯頁 / 實體頁）** — The host-sized unit the map tracks, and the flash page that stores it, often holding several logical pages. → [§4.2.2](../core/ch4-ftl.md#422-how-mapping-works-and-the-dram-question)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logical unit (LU) { #term-logical-unit-lu .sdd-term }

**邏輯單元** — An independently addressed storage space with its own LBA range, UFS's counterpart of an NVMe namespace. → [§B.4](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b4-logical-units)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### logical-to-physical map (L2P) { #term-logical-to-physical-map-l2p .sdd-term }

**邏輯到物理映射表（台：邏輯至實體映射表）** — The FTL's table from each logical address to the flash location that holds it. → [§B.8](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b8-hpb-host-performance-booster)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### low-density parity-check code (LDPC) { #term-low-density-parity-check-code-ldpc .sdd-term }

**低密度奇偶校驗碼（台：低密度同位元檢查碼）** — A linear code whose parity-check matrix is sparse, decoded iteratively with soft information. → [§A.4.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a41-what-ldpc-is)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### LTSSM { #term-ltssm .sdd-term }

Link Training and Status State Machine (PCIe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### LUN { #term-lun .sdd-term }

logical unit number  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## M { #letter-m }

### M-PHY { #term-m-phy .sdd-term }

**M-PHY物理層（台：M-PHY實體層）** — UFS's physical layer: differential serial lanes whose speed grade is the Gear. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### (main) controller { #term-main-controller .sdd-term }

**主控（台：主控晶片）** — The processor chip that runs the firmware and manages the host interface, the flash and the data path. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is); The SoC that runs the firmware and moves data between the host interface and the flash. → [§2.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#21-ssd-system-architecture)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### managed NAND { #term-managed-nand .sdd-term }

**管理型NAND** — Controller, flash and firmware in one package, so the host never handles raw flash. → [§B.1](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b1-what-ufs-is-the-emmc-successor)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### mapping / map table (L2P) { #term-mapping-map-table-l2p .sdd-term }

**映射 / 映射表** — The logical-to-physical table that records which flash page holds each logical page. → [§4.2.2](../core/ch4-ftl.md#422-how-mapping-works-and-the-dram-question)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### mapping table { #term-mapping-table .sdd-term }

**映射表** — The FTL's table from each logical block address to the flash location holding its current data. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Max Payload Size (MPS) { #term-max-payload-size-mps .sdd-term }

**最大有效載荷（台：最大酬載大小）** — The largest payload one TLP may carry, set to the smallest capability on the path. → [§5.11](../core/ch5-pcie.md#511-max-payload-size-max-read-request-size)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MBR { #term-mbr .sdd-term }

Master Boot Record (legacy partition table)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MBU / MEU { #term-mbu-meu .sdd-term }

Multiple-Bit Upset — one strike flips adjacent bits (challenges ECC)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MCU { #term-mcu .sdd-term }

microcontroller unit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MDAT { #term-mdat .sdd-term }

Minimum DEVSLP Assertion Time (SATA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### memory mapping { #term-memory-mapping .sdd-term }

**內存映射（台：記憶體映射）** — Making a device's registers appear as host memory addresses, so the CPU reaches them with ordinary reads and writes. → [§5.6](../core/ch5-pcie.md#56-config-space-and-bars)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### message authentication code (MAC / HMAC) { #term-message-authentication-code-mac-hmac .sdd-term }

**消息認證碼（台：訊息鑑別碼）** — A keyed checksum proving that a message came from a key holder and was not altered; RPMB uses HMAC-SHA256. → [§B.5](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b5-rpmb-replay-protected-memory-block)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### metadata { #term-metadata .sdd-term }

**元數據（台：中繼資料）** — Data about data, such as XtremIO's address-to-hash and hash-to-physical tables. → [§2.6.4](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#264-workflow-how-io-actually-flows); Information stored with each flash page, chiefly its LBA and a timestamp, which lets the map be rebuilt. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery); Extra bytes stored with each logical block, which can hold the Protection Information. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### min-sum { #term-min-sum .sdd-term }

**最小和算法（台：最小和演算法）** — The hardware-friendly approximation of sum-product: the sign from the product of signs, the size from the smallest input. → [§A.5.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a52-sum-product-belief-propagation-soft-decision)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### minimum distance dmin { #term-minimum-distance-dmin .sdd-term }

**最小距離** — The smallest Hamming distance between any two codewords; it fixes how many errors a code can detect and correct. → [§A.3.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a31-hamming-distance-the-concept-everything-rests-on)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MIPI { #term-mipi .sdd-term }

MIPI Alliance (mobile interface standards body)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MIPI Alliance { #term-mipi-alliance .sdd-term }

**MIPI聯盟** — The consortium that writes mobile interface standards, including UniPro and M-PHY. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### mirroring { #term-mirroring .sdd-term }

**鏡像** — Keeping two copies of the data, so either can serve it if the other fails. → [§2.6.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#263-software-architecture-the-real-value)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MLC { #term-mlc .sdd-term }

multi-level cell (2 bits per cell)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### Modern Standby { #term-modern-standby .sdd-term }

instant-on always-connected standby (needs RTD3)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MOSFET { #term-mosfet .sdd-term }

metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistor  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MP / ENLAT / EXLAT { #term-mp-enlat-exlat .sdd-term }

Max Power / entry latency / exit latency (state descriptor)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MRAM { #term-mram .sdd-term }

magnetoresistive RAM  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MRd { #term-mrd .sdd-term }

Memory Read request (PCIe TLP)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MSI-X { #term-msi-x .sdd-term }

Message Signaled Interrupts, extended (an interrupt sent as a memory write)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MT { #term-mt .sdd-term }

megatransfers (MT/s = millions of transfers per second)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### MTBF { #term-mtbf .sdd-term }

mean time between failures  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### Multi-Circular Queue (MCQ) { #term-multi-circular-queue-mcq .sdd-term }

**多循環隊列（台：多重環狀佇列）** — UFS 4.0's multiple submission and completion queues, so each CPU core can submit in parallel. → [§B.9](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b9-modern-developments-ufs-41-and-50)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### multi-head logging { #term-multi-head-logging .sdd-term }

6 logs separating hot/warm/cold data (≈ WL hot/cold, Ch4)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### multipath { #term-multipath .sdd-term }

**多路徑** — Reaching the same namespace over more than one path, for redundancy or bandwidth. → [§6.8](../core/ch6-nvme.md#68-nvme-over-fabrics)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### MWr { #term-mwr .sdd-term }

Memory Write request (PCIe TLP)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## N { #letter-n }

### NAK { #term-nak .sdd-term }

negative acknowledgment  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### namespace (NS) { #term-namespace-ns .sdd-term }

**命名空間** — An independent logical drive carved out of an NVMe SSD, with its own LBA range and ID. → [§6.7](../core/ch6-nvme.md#67-namespaces)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### NAT (Node Address Table) { #term-nat-node-address-table .sdd-term }

node ID → physical address indirection (≈ FTL map, Ch4)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### NCQ { #term-ncq .sdd-term }

Native Command Queuing (SATA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NEPP { #term-nepp .sdd-term }

NASA Electronic Parts and Packaging program  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NGFF { #term-ngff .sdd-term }

Next Generation Form Factor (M.2's original name)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NIC { #term-nic .sdd-term }

network interface card  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### node { #term-node .sdd-term }

F2FS metadata unit: inode / direct node / indirect node  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### non-volatile { #term-non-volatile .sdd-term }

**非易失性（台：非揮發性）** — Keeping data with the power off. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### normal / abnormal power loss { #term-normal-abnormal-power-loss .sdd-term }

**正常/異常掉電（台：正常/異常斷電）** — Power-off after the host warns the drive and it flushes everything, versus power vanishing without warning. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### normalized / offset min-sum { #term-normalized-offset-min-sum .sdd-term }

**歸一化 / 偏移最小和（台：正規化 / 偏移最小和）** — Min-sum corrected for its overconfidence, by scaling the messages down or subtracting a constant. → [§A.5.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a52-sum-product-belief-propagation-soft-decision)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### NQN { #term-nqn .sdd-term }

NVMe Qualified Name  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NRZ { #term-nrz .sdd-term }

non-return-to-zero (two-level signaling)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NSID { #term-nsid .sdd-term }

namespace identifier (NVMe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NSREC { #term-nsrec .sdd-term }

Nuclear and Space Radiation Effects Conference  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NUMA { #term-numa .sdd-term }

non-uniform memory access (each CPU has its own nearby memory)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NVM { #term-nvm .sdd-term }

non-volatile memory  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NVMe { #term-nvme .sdd-term }

NVM Express (the SSD command protocol that runs over PCIe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NVMe power state (PS0–PS31) { #term-nvme-power-state-ps0ps31 .sdd-term }

up to 32 controller power states in Identify data  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### NVMe-MI { #term-nvme-mi .sdd-term }

NVMe Management Interface (out-of-band drive management)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### NVMe-oF { #term-nvme-of .sdd-term }

NVMe over Fabrics  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## O { #letter-o }

### OLTP { #term-oltp .sdd-term }

online transaction processing  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### ONFI { #term-onfi .sdd-term }

Open NAND Flash Interface  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### OOB { #term-oob .sdd-term }

out-of-band (SATA link signaling)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### operational / non-operational { #term-operational-non-operational .sdd-term }

NVMe states that can / cannot process I/O  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ordered / writeback / journal mode { #term-ordered-writeback-journal-mode .sdd-term }

EXT4 journaling modes  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### original flash manufacturer (fab) { #term-original-flash-manufacturer-fab .sdd-term }

**原廠** — A company that makes its own NAND flash, such as Samsung, SK hynix or Kioxia. → [§1.7](../core/ch1-overview.md#17-the-solid-state-storage-market)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### OS { #term-os .sdd-term }

operating system  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### out-of-band management { #term-out-of-band-management .sdd-term }

**帶外管理（台：頻外管理）** — Monitoring and controlling a device over a separate path, such as SMBus, that works without the host operating system. → [§2.8.6](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#286-sideband-signals-reset-clock-wake-and-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### over-provisioning (OP) { #term-over-provisioning-op .sdd-term }

**預留空間** — Flash kept beyond the user capacity, as a fraction of user space; more OP makes GC cheaper and WA lower. → [§4.3.2](../core/ch4-ftl.md#432-write-amplification)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### overwrite-in-place { #term-overwrite-in-place .sdd-term }

**覆蓋寫（台：覆寫）** — Writing new data over old data at the same address, which flash cannot do. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## P { #letter-p }

### P2L { #term-p2l .sdd-term }

physical-to-logical (reverse map)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### packet { #term-packet .sdd-term }

**數據包（台：封包）** — A unit of data with its own header and checks, as sent across a link. → [§5.3](../core/ch5-pcie.md#53-the-three-layer-stack)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PAM4 { #term-pam4 .sdd-term }

4-level pulse-amplitude modulation  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### parity-check matrix H { #term-parity-check-matrix-h .sdd-term }

**校驗矩陣（台：同位檢查矩陣）** — The (n − k) × n matrix whose rows are the parity equations; every codeword satisfies H·cᵀ = 0. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Partial / Slumber / DevSleep { #term-partial-slumber-devsleep .sdd-term }

SATA link low-power states (≈ L0s / L1 / L1.2+RTD3)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### payload { #term-payload .sdd-term }

**有效載荷（台：酬載）** — The data a TLP carries, as opposed to its header and checks. → [§5.5](../core/ch5-pcie.md#55-tlp-structure)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PCB { #term-pcb .sdd-term }

printed circuit board  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### PCI { #term-pci .sdd-term }

Peripheral Component Interconnect  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### PCIe { #term-pcie .sdd-term }

PCI Express (Peripheral Component Interconnect Express)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### performance loss { #term-performance-loss .sdd-term }

**性能損耗（台：效能損耗）** — The gap between line rate and real throughput, from encoding, packet overhead and the link protocol. → [§5.13](../core/ch5-pcie.md#513-pcie-link-performance-loss-analysis)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### performance testing { #term-performance-testing .sdd-term }

**性能測試（台：效能測試）** — Measuring throughput, IOPS and latency under defined workloads and drive states. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PERST { #term-perst .sdd-term }

PCIe reset signal (PERST#)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### PEWAKE { #term-pewake .sdd-term }

PCIe wake signal (PEWAKE#)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### Phase Tag { #term-phase-tag .sdd-term }

**相位標籤** — A bit in each completion entry that flips every lap of the CQ, so the host can find new entries without reading a register. → [§6.3](../core/ch6-nvme.md#63-the-three-treasures-in-detail)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### phase-change memory (PCM) { #term-phase-change-memory-pcm .sdd-term }

**相變存儲器（台：相變化記憶體）** — Memory that stores a bit as the amorphous or crystalline state of a chalcogenide; 3D XPoint belonged to this family. → [§3.1.7](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#317-3d-xpoint-and-the-emerging-memory-zoo)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PHY / physical layer { #term-phy-physical-layer .sdd-term }

**物理層（台：實體層）** — The circuitry that sends and receives the raw serial bit stream on the link. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Physical Layer { #term-physical-layer .sdd-term }

**物理層（台：實體層）** — The bottom layer: framing, striping, scrambling, encoding and differential signaling. → [§5.9](../core/ch5-pcie.md#59-physical-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Physical Region Page (PRP) { #term-physical-region-page-prp .sdd-term }

**物理區域頁（台：實體區域頁）** — An NVMe pointer to a host memory page; PRP lists describe longer buffers in whole pages. → [§6.4](../core/ch6-nvme.md#64-the-addressing-duo-prp-and-sgl)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### plane { #term-plane .sdd-term }

**平面** — A slice of a die with its own registers; planes can work in parallel within one die. → [§3.1.3](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#313-the-hierarchy-cell-page-block-plane-die)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PLC { #term-plc .sdd-term }

penta-level cell (5 bits per cell)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### PLL { #term-pll .sdd-term }

phase-locked loop (clock generator)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### PME { #term-pme .sdd-term }

Power Management Event (device-initiated wake signal)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### point-to-point { #term-point-to-point .sdd-term }

**點到點（台：點對點）** — Each link connects exactly two devices and its bandwidth is theirs alone. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power consumption { #term-power-consumption .sdd-term }

**功耗** — The power a drive draws in each state, from active down to DevSleep. → [§1.5.5](../core/ch1-overview.md#155-power-thermals)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power loss / power on { #term-power-loss-power-on .sdd-term }

**掉電 / 上電（台：斷電 / 通電）** — Losing or restoring supply power; an SSD must survive a sudden loss without corrupting its data. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power management IC (PMIC) { #term-power-management-ic-pmic .sdd-term }

**電源管理芯片（台：電源管理晶片）** — The chip that turns the supply voltage into the board's rails and brings them up in the right order. → [§2.8.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#281-power-the-pmic-and-its-rails)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power-loss protection (PLP) { #term-power-loss-protection-plp .sdd-term }

**掉電保護（台：斷電保護）** — Capacitors and firmware that keep a drive running long enough to save its buffered data when power fails. → [§2.8.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#283-power-loss-protection-capacitors-that-buy-milliseconds)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power-loss recovery { #term-power-loss-recovery .sdd-term }

**掉電恢復（台：斷電復原）** — Rebuilding a consistent map and drive state after the power is cut without warning. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### power-vs-latency tradeoff { #term-power-vs-latency-tradeoff .sdd-term }

deeper state = less power but slower wake (the core principle)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### preconditioning { #term-preconditioning .sdd-term }

**預處理** — Writing a drive into steady state before measuring: generic writes first, then the test workload. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### producer / consumer { #term-producer-consumer .sdd-term }

**生產者 / 消費者** — The side that adds entries to a queue (and owns its tail), and the side that removes them (and owns its head). → [§6.3](../core/ch6-nvme.md#63-the-three-treasures-in-detail)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### program disturb { #term-program-disturb .sdd-term }

**寫干擾 / 編程干擾（台：寫入干擾）** — Unwanted charge added to cells near the ones being programmed. → [§3.3.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#331-the-five-problems-a-catalog-to-know-cold)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Protection Information (PI) { #term-protection-information-pi .sdd-term }

**保護信息（台：保護資訊）** — Eight bytes per block: a CRC guard, an application tag and a reference tag tied to the LBA. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)
