<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### protocol analyzer { #term-protocol-analyzer .sdd-term }

**協議分析儀（台：協定分析儀）** — An instrument that records and decodes every packet on a link without changing it. → [§7.3.2](../core/ch7-testing.md#732-protocol-analyzer)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### purge { #term-purge .sdd-term }

**擦除（台：清除）** — Returning a drive to a known clean state before a test, by Security Erase, Sanitize or a vendor tool. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### PWRDIS { #term-pwrdis .sdd-term }

power disable (EDSFF sideband signal)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## Q { #letter-q }

### QC-LDPC { #term-qc-ldpc .sdd-term }

**準循環LDPC碼** — Quasi-cyclic LDPC: H built from small circulant blocks, which makes encoders and decoders compact and parallel. → [§A.6](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a6-ldpc-encoding)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### QLC { #term-qlc .sdd-term }

quad-level cell (4 bits per cell)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### QoS { #term-qos .sdd-term }

quality of service (how consistent latency is)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### quantum tunneling { #term-quantum-tunneling .sdd-term }

**量子隧道效應（台：量子穿隧效應）** — Electrons crossing an insulator under a strong field, the effect that programs and erases a cell. → [§3.1.4](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#314-read-write-erase-the-actual-voltages)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### queue depth { #term-queue-depth .sdd-term }

**隊列深度（台：佇列深度）** — How many commands a queue can hold in flight; NVMe allows up to 64K per queue. → [§6.1](../core/ch6-nvme.md#61-from-ahci-to-nvme); How many commands a test keeps outstanding at once. → [§7.1.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#711-fio-the-king-of-performance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## R { #letter-r }

### rad / krad / Gray { #term-rad-krad-gray .sdd-term }

units of absorbed radiation dose  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### rad-hard vs rad-tolerant { #term-rad-hard-vs-rad-tolerant .sdd-term }

hardened silicon vs COTS + system mitigation  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RAID { #term-raid .sdd-term }

redundant array of independent disks  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### RAM { #term-ram .sdd-term }

random-access memory  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### random / sequential { #term-random-sequential .sdd-term }

**隨機 / 順序(連續)（台：隨機 / 循序）** — Whether consecutive commands target scattered or contiguous logical addresses. → [§1.5.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#152-performance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### raw capacity / user capacity { #term-raw-capacity-user-capacity .sdd-term }

**裸容量 / 用戶容量（台：原始容量 / 使用者容量）** — All the flash on board versus the space the host can use; the difference is over-provisioning. → [§1.5.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#151-basic-information)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### raw-flash FS (JFFS2/UBIFS) { #term-raw-flash-fs-jffs2ubifs .sdd-term }

filesystems that replace the FTL, managing bare NAND  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RBER / UBER { #term-rber-uber .sdd-term }

**原始誤碼率 / 不可糾正誤碼率（台：原始位元錯誤率 / 無法更正位元錯誤率）** — The raw bit error rate of the flash before ECC, and the uncorrectable bit error rate users see after it. → [§A.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a1-signal-and-noise-the-framing)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RCB { #term-rcb .sdd-term }

Read Completion Boundary (PCIe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### RD { #term-rd .sdd-term }

read disturb  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### read disturb { #term-read-disturb .sdd-term }

**讀干擾（台：讀取干擾）** — Bit errors that build up in a block's other pages because every read stresses them with pass voltage. → [§3.3.5](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#335-read-disturb-in-the-field)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### read retry { #term-read-retry .sdd-term }

**重讀（台：重新讀取）** — Re-reading a page with shifted reference voltages when decoding fails. → [§3.4.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#342-read-retry); Re-reading at shifted reference voltages when decoding fails; soft reads extend it. → [§A.7](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a7-the-ldpc-codec-inside-the-ssd)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### read scrub { #term-read-scrub .sdd-term }

**掃描重寫 / 數據巡檢（台：資料巡檢）** — Scanning data in idle time and rewriting pages whose error counts are climbing. → [§3.3.6](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#336-data-retention-how-long-does-data-survive)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### redundancy / fault tolerance { #term-redundancy-fault-tolerance .sdd-term }

**冗餘容錯** — Spare paths or copies that keep a system working when one part fails. → [§6.7](../core/ch6-nvme.md#67-namespaces)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### redundancy / parity { #term-redundancy-parity .sdd-term }

**冗餘 / 校驗位（台：冗餘 / 同位元）** — Extra bits stored with the data so that errors can be detected and corrected. → [§A.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a1-signal-and-noise-the-framing)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### redundancy / parity check { #term-redundancy-parity-check .sdd-term }

**冗餘校驗（台：冗餘檢查）** — Extra data, such as parity across dies or a CRC on a data path, that lets the controller detect or rebuild damaged data. → [§2.5](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#25-case-study-dera-tai-an-enterprise-nvme-asic)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### reference clock (REFCLK) { #term-reference-clock-refclk .sdd-term }

**參考時鐘（台：參考時脈）** — The 100 MHz clock the host sends alongside the PCIe lanes. → [§2.8.6](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#286-sideband-signals-reset-clock-wake-and-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### reference count { #term-reference-count .sdd-term }

**引用數（台：參照計數）** — How many logical addresses point at one stored block; a duplicate write raises it instead of writing data. → [§2.6.4](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#264-workflow-how-io-actually-flows)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Reference Tag { #term-reference-tag .sdd-term }

**參考標籤** — The PI field tied to the block's LBA, which catches a valid block delivered for the wrong address. → [§6.6](../core/ch6-nvme.md#66-end-to-end-data-protection)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### regression test { #term-regression-test .sdd-term }

**回歸測試** — Re-running existing tests on each new build to catch anything it broke. → [§7.4](../core/ch7-testing.md#74-regression-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### regular / irregular LDPC { #term-regular-irregular-ldpc .sdd-term }

**規則 / 非規則（台：規則 / 不規則）** — Uniform versus varied row and column weights in H; production codes are irregular. → [§A.4.1](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a41-what-ldpc-is)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### reliability { #term-reliability .sdd-term }

**可靠性（台：可靠度）** — How rarely a drive returns wrong data or fails, stated as UBER and MTBF. → [§1.5.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#154-data-reliability)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### remap table { #term-remap-table .sdd-term }

**重映射表** — The table that redirects each replaced bad block to its spare. → [§4.7](../core/ch4-ftl.md#47-bad-block-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### remote direct memory access (RDMA) { #term-remote-direct-memory-access-rdma .sdd-term }

**遠程直接內存訪問（台：遠端直接記憶體存取）** — Moving data straight into another machine's memory without copies or kernel work; NVMe-oF's lowest-latency transport. → [§6.8](../core/ch6-nvme.md#68-nvme-over-fabrics)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### replay attack { #term-replay-attack .sdd-term }

**重放攻擊（台：重送攻擊）** — Re-sending a recorded legitimate message later to undo a security state. → [§B.5](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b5-rpmb-replay-protected-memory-block)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Replay Protected Memory Block (RPMB) { #term-replay-protected-memory-block-rpmb .sdd-term }

**重放保護內存塊（台：重放保護記憶體區塊）** — A small authenticated region whose writes need a valid MAC and the current write counter. → [§B.5](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b5-rpmb-replay-protected-memory-block)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### retransmission (retry) { #term-retransmission-retry .sdd-term }

**重傳** — Resending TLPs from the replay buffer after a NAK or timeout. → [§5.8](../core/ch5-pcie.md#58-data-link-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RHA { #term-rha .sdd-term }

Radiation Hardness Assurance  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RHBD / RHBP { #term-rhbd-rhbp .sdd-term }

Rad-Hardening By Design / By Process  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ring / circular queue { #term-ring-circular-queue .sdd-term }

**環形隊列（台：環狀佇列）** — A fixed array whose end wraps to its start, filled at the tail and emptied at the head. → [§6.3](../core/ch6-nvme.md#63-the-three-treasures-in-detail)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### robustness { #term-robustness .sdd-term }

**健壯性（台：強健性）** — Continuing to work correctly when the host or link misbehaves. → [§7.3.3](../core/ch7-testing.md#733-jammer)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Root Complex (RC) { #term-root-complex-rc .sdd-term }

**根複合體** — The root of the PCIe tree, which connects the CPU and memory to PCIe and alone may start configuration. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### routing { #term-routing .sdd-term }

**路由** — How a TLP finds its destination: by address, by ID (BDF), or implicitly. → [§5.7](../core/ch5-pcie.md#57-tlp-routing)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### routing module { #term-routing-module .sdd-term }

**路由模塊（台：路由模組）** — XtremIO's R module: it owns the host ports, splits IO into 4 KB blocks and hashes each one. → [§2.6.4](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#264-workflow-how-io-actually-flows)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### row address / column address { #term-row-address-column-address .sdd-term }

**行地址 / 列地址（台：列位址 / 行位址）** — The address of a page (LUN, block, page) and the byte offset within it. Note the swap: the mainland calls a row 行, Taiwan calls it 列. → [§3.2.4](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#324-addressing)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RPC { #term-rpc .sdd-term }

remote procedure call  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### RRAM { #term-rram .sdd-term }

resistive RAM  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### RTD3 { #term-rtd3 .sdd-term }

Runtime D3 — remove main power at runtime for near-zero idle  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RTD3R { #term-rtd3r .sdd-term }

RTD3 resume latency (≤100 ms target for Modern Standby)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### RTL { #term-rtl .sdd-term }

register-transfer level (hardware design description)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## S { #letter-s }

### S0–S5 { #term-s0s5 .sdd-term }

host ACPI system power states (working → off)  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### sample size { #term-sample-size .sdd-term }

**樣本大小（台：樣本數）** — How many drives a qualification must test, set by the FFR and UBER constraints. → [§7.8](../core/ch7-testing.md#78-endurance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SAN { #term-san .sdd-term }

storage area network  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SAS { #term-sas .sdd-term }

Serial Attached SCSI  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SATA { #term-sata .sdd-term }

Serial ATA  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### Scatter/Gather List (SGL) { #term-scattergather-list-sgl .sdd-term }

**分散聚集列表（台：分散/聚集清單）** — An NVMe linked list of descriptors that can name memory regions of any address and length. → [§6.4](../core/ch6-nvme.md#64-the-addressing-duo-prp-and-sgl)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### scramble / de-scramble { #term-scramble-de-scramble .sdd-term }

**加擾 / 去擾（台：擾碼 / 解擾）** — Mixing the bit stream with a pseudo-random pattern (and undoing it) to avoid long runs that cause EMI. → [§5.9](../core/ch5-pcie.md#59-physical-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SCSI { #term-scsi .sdd-term }

Small Computer System Interface  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SDK { #term-sdk .sdd-term }

software development kit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SEE { #term-see .sdd-term }

Single Event Effect — single-particle-strike disruption  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SEFI { #term-sefi .sdd-term }

Single Event Functional Interrupt — device hangs, needs reset  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### segment { #term-segment .sdd-term }

**段（台：區段）** — A group of SGL descriptors stored together; segments chain to form the list. → [§6.4](../core/ch6-nvme.md#64-the-addressing-duo-prp-and-sgl)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### segment / section / zone { #term-segment-section-zone .sdd-term }

F2FS allocation units (2 MB / group / group of sections)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SEGR / SEB { #term-segr-seb .sdd-term }

Single Event Gate Rupture / Burnout — destructive, high-voltage nodes  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SEL { #term-sel .sdd-term }

Single Event Latchup — destructive high-current short  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### sequence number { #term-sequence-number .sdd-term }

**序列號（台：序號）** — A number the Data Link Layer stamps on each TLP so the receiver can detect gaps and duplicates. → [§5.8](../core/ch5-pcie.md#58-data-link-layer)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### sequential / random read-write { #term-sequential-random-read-write .sdd-term }

**順序 / 隨機讀寫（台：循序 / 隨機讀寫）** — Accessing consecutive addresses versus scattered ones; the two stress a drive very differently. → [§7.1.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#711-fio-the-king-of-performance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### serial / parallel bus { #term-serial-parallel-bus .sdd-term }

**串行 / 並行總線（台：序列 / 平行匯流排）** — Sending bits one after another on few wires, versus many bits at once on many wires sharing a clock. → [§5.1](../core/ch5-pcie.md#51-starting-with-speed)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SET { #term-set .sdd-term }

Single Event Transient — voltage glitch  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SEU { #term-seu .sdd-term }

Single Event Upset — soft bit flip (≈ Ch3 bit error)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SHA { #term-sha .sdd-term }

Secure Hash Algorithm  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### shadow copy { #term-shadow-copy .sdd-term }

two-copy scheme; one always valid  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### sideband signal { #term-sideband-signal .sdd-term }

**邊帶信號（台：邊帶訊號）** — A slow single-purpose wire beside the data lanes, such as PERST# (reset) or CLKREQ# (clock request). → [§2.8.6](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#286-sideband-signals-reset-clock-wake-and-management); A dedicated wire beside the data path; PCIe moved most of PCI's onto in-band messages. → [§5.4](../core/ch5-pcie.md#54-tlp-types)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### simulation / emulation { #term-simulation-emulation .sdd-term }

**仿真 / 模擬** — Modelling a chip in software, versus reproducing its design in hardware that runs at speed. → [§7.3.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#731-emulator-vs-fpga)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SIT (Segment Info Table) { #term-sit-segment-info-table .sdd-term }

valid-block counts/bitmaps (≈ SSD VPC/VPBM, Ch4)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### skip / replace strategy { #term-skip-replace-strategy .sdd-term }

**略過 / 替換策略** — Stepping over bad blocks, versus remapping each one to a spare on the same die so parallelism stays steady. → [§4.7](../core/ch4-ftl.md#47-bad-block-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SLC cache { #term-slc-cache .sdd-term }

**SLC 緩存（台：SLC 快取）** — TLC or QLC blocks run in fast, robust one-bit-per-cell mode to absorb bursts of writes. → [§4.8](../core/ch4-ftl.md#48-slc-cache)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SMART { #term-smart .sdd-term }

Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology (drive health data)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SMP / AMP { #term-smp-amp .sdd-term }

**對稱/非對稱多處理** — Cores sharing one code image and one memory (symmetric) versus each core running its own code from its own memory (asymmetric). → [§2.1.2](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#212-controller-cpu-cpu)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### snapshot / checkpoint { #term-snapshot-checkpoint .sdd-term }

**快照 / 檢查點** — A periodic save of the map and drive state, so a rebuild only scans pages written since. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SNIA { #term-snia .sdd-term }

Storage Networking Industry Association  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### software-defined flash (SDF) { #term-software-defined-flash-sdf .sdd-term }

**軟件定義閃存（台：軟體定義快閃記憶體）** — Baidu's host-managed flash design, which writes whole erase blocks and so needs no GC. → [§4.10](../core/ch4-ftl.md#410-host-based-ftl)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SOI { #term-soi .sdd-term }

Silicon-On-Insulator (latchup-resistant substrate)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### solid-state drive (SSD) { #term-solid-state-drive-ssd .sdd-term }

**固態硬盤（台：固態硬碟）** — A storage device that keeps data as charge in flash chips, run by a controller, with no moving parts. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### source block / destination block { #term-source-block-destination-block .sdd-term }

**源閃存塊 / 目標閃存塊（台：來源區塊 / 目標區塊）** — The victim block GC copies valid data out of, and the fresh block it copies into. → [§4.3.3](../core/ch4-ftl.md#433-gc-implementation-three-steps)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### South Atlantic Anomaly { #term-south-atlantic-anomaly .sdd-term }

LEO region of elevated radiation  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SPDK { #term-spdk .sdd-term }

Storage Performance Development Kit (user-space NVMe driver)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SPE { #term-spe .sdd-term }

Solar Particle Event (flare/CME particle burst)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SPI { #term-spi .sdd-term }

Serial Peripheral Interface  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SR-IOV { #term-sr-iov .sdd-term }

single-root I/O virtualization (one PCIe device appears as many)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SRAM { #term-sram .sdd-term }

static random-access memory  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### SSA (Segment Summary Area) { #term-ssa-segment-summary-area .sdd-term }

block → owning node (≈ SSD P2L, Ch4)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### SSR / MMU { #term-ssr-mmu .sdd-term }

Solid State Recorder / Mass Memory Unit (spacecraft storage)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### stacked gate layers { #term-stacked-gate-layers .sdd-term }

**堆疊柵極層（台：堆疊閘極層）** — The wordline layers of 3D flash; each one forms a cell where it meets a channel hole. → [§3.1.5](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#315-3d-flash)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### static power management { #term-static-power-management .sdd-term }

host pins the drive to a power budget  
<small>From: [Supp D — Power Management](../supplements/d-power-management.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### steady state { #term-steady-state .sdd-term }

**穩定態（台：穩態）** — The phase where performance varies by no more than ±10%; SNIA measures only here. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### storage controller { #term-storage-controller .sdd-term }

**存儲控制器（台：儲存控制器）** — In an array, the server that runs the storage software and connects the hosts to the drives. → [§2.6.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#261-the-anatomy)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### storage medium { #term-storage-medium .sdd-term }

**介質（台：儲存媒體）** — The physical material that holds the bits: magnetic platters, optical discs or flash cells. → [§1.1](../core/ch1-overview.md#11-the-hook-what-an-ssd-is)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### (storage) cell { #term-storage-cell .sdd-term }

**存儲單元（台：儲存單元）** — One transistor that holds one or more bits as trapped charge. → [§3.1.1](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#311-how-a-flash-cell-works)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Submission Queue (SQ) { #term-submission-queue-sq .sdd-term }

**提交隊列（台：提交佇列）** — A ring in host memory where the host places 64-byte commands for the SSD to fetch. → [§6.2](../core/ch6-nvme.md#62-nvme-overview-the-command-model)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### superblock (SB) { #term-superblock-sb .sdd-term }

filesystem-wide metadata  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### switch { #term-switch .sdd-term }

**交換機 (Switch)（台：交換器）** — A branch of the tree that fans one upstream port out into several downstream ports and routes TLPs between them. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### synchronous / asynchronous { #term-synchronous-asynchronous .sdd-term }

**同步 / 異步（台：同步 / 非同步）** — Interface timing with a clock and strobe versus pulse-driven timing without a clock. → [§3.2.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#322-synchronous-timing); Waiting for each I/O to finish before issuing the next, versus issuing many and collecting completions later. → [§7.1.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#711-fio-the-king-of-performance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### syndrome s = H·rᵀ { #term-syndrome-s-hrt .sdd-term }

**伴隨式（台：症狀）** — The parity-check results for a received word; it depends only on the error and is zero when no error is detected. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### System Management Bus (SMBus) { #term-system-management-bus-smbus .sdd-term }

**系統管理總線（台：系統管理匯流排）** — A two-wire management bus on the connector, used to monitor drives through NVMe-MI. → [§2.8.6](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#286-sideband-signals-reset-clock-wake-and-management)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### system on chip (SoC) { #term-system-on-chip-soc .sdd-term }

**片上系統（台：系統單晶片）** — One chip holding processor cores, memory, buses and hardware engines: a complete small computer. → [§2.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#21-ssd-system-architecture)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### systematic form { #term-systematic-form .sdd-term }

**系統形式** — G = [I \| P], so the data appears unchanged in the codeword, followed by its parity. → [§A.3.3](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a33-the-generator-matrix-g-and-parity-check-matrix-h)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## T { #letter-t }

### Tanner graph { #term-tanner-graph .sdd-term }

**Tanner圖** — The bipartite graph of a code: variable nodes for bits, check nodes for parity equations, an edge for every 1 in H. → [§A.4.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a42-the-tanner-graph)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### TCAT { #term-tcat .sdd-term }

Terabit Cell Array Transistor (Samsung 3D NAND structure)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### TCP { #term-tcp .sdd-term }

Transmission Control Protocol  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### temperature acceleration { #term-temperature-acceleration .sdd-term }

**溫度加速** — Testing hot so that flash ages faster and a year of use fits into days. → [§7.8](../core/ch7-testing.md#78-endurance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### terabytes written (TBW) { #term-terabytes-written-tbw .sdd-term }

**總寫入量** — The endurance rating: how much data the host may write over the drive's life. → [§7.8](../core/ch7-testing.md#78-endurance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### thread { #term-thread .sdd-term }

**線程（台：執行緒）** — One stream of execution; a benchmark uses several to keep many I/Os in flight. → [§7.1.1](../core/ch7-testing.md#711-fio-the-king-of-performance-testing)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### threshold voltage { #term-threshold-voltage .sdd-term }

**閾值電壓（台：臨界電壓）** — The gate voltage at which a cell starts to conduct; the stored charge sets it, so it encodes the data. → [§3.1.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#312-slc-mlc-tlc-the-threshold-voltage-picture)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### throughput / bandwidth { #term-throughput-bandwidth .sdd-term }

**吞吐量 / 帶寬（台：吞吐量 / 頻寬）** — Data moved per second (MB/s), the measure of sequential transfers. → [§1.5.2](../core/ch1-overview.md#152-performance)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### TID { #term-tid .sdd-term }

Total Ionizing Dose — cumulative radiation damage (≈ radiation-driven wear, Ch3)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### timestamp { #term-timestamp .sdd-term }

**時間戳（台：時間戳記）** — A sequence number written with each page; during a rebuild the newest copy of an LBA wins. → [§4.6](../core/ch4-ftl.md#46-power-loss-recovery)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### TLC { #term-tlc .sdd-term }

triple-level cell (3 bits per cell)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### TMR { #term-tmr .sdd-term }

Triple Modular Redundancy (triplicate + vote)  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### topology { #term-topology .sdd-term }

**拓撲結構（台：拓樸結構）** — How the devices of a system are connected; PCIe's is a tree. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Transaction Layer { #term-transaction-layer .sdd-term }

**事務層（台：交易層）** — The top layer: builds and parses TLPs, and handles ordering and flow control. → [§5.3](../core/ch5-pcie.md#53-the-three-layer-stack)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Transaction Layer Packet (TLP) { #term-transaction-layer-packet-tlp .sdd-term }

**事務層數據包（台：交易層封包）** — The packet that carries requests, completions and data end to end. → [§5.4](../core/ch5-pcie.md#54-tlp-types)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### tree structure { #term-tree-structure .sdd-term }

**樹形結構（台：樹狀結構）** — A hierarchy with one root, branches (switches) and leaves (endpoints). → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### trigger { #term-trigger .sdd-term }

**觸發** — The condition that makes an analyzer start or keep a capture. → [§7.3.2](../core/ch7-testing.md#732-protocol-analyzer)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Trim { #term-trim .sdd-term }

**Trim 指令** — The host telling the drive which LBAs it no longer needs (Deallocate in NVMe, UNMAP in SCSI), so GC stops copying them. → [§4.4](../core/ch4-ftl.md#44-trim)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### tunnel oxide { #term-tunnel-oxide .sdd-term }

**隧道氧化層（台：穿隧氧化層）** — The thin insulator electrons tunnel through to enter or leave the storage layer; it wears with every cycle. → [§3.3.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#332-endurance-the-physics-of-wearing-out)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### turnkey solution { #term-turnkey-solution .sdd-term }

**交鑰匙方案（台：統包方案）** — A controller sold with firmware, a reference board and flash pairing, so a small brand can ship a drive quickly. → [§2.2.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#223-taiwanese-mainland-chinese-controllers)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### two-level mapping { #term-two-level-mapping .sdd-term }

**二級映射** — A DRAM-less scheme: a small index in SRAM points to map pages kept in flash and cached on demand. → [§4.2.2](../core/ch4-ftl.md#422-how-mapping-works-and-the-dram-question)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## U { #letter-u }

### UAP { #term-uap .sdd-term }

UFS Application Layer  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### UART { #term-uart .sdd-term }

universal asynchronous receiver-transmitter (serial port)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### UCL { #term-ucl .sdd-term }

upper confidence limit  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### UFS InterConnect layer (UIC) { #term-ufs-interconnect-layer-uic .sdd-term }

**UFS互連層** — UniPro and M-PHY together, the link-plus-physical foundation of the stack. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### UFS Protocol Information Unit (UPIU) { #term-ufs-protocol-information-unit-upiu .sdd-term }

**UFS協議信息單元（台：UFS協定資訊單元）** — The UFS packet: a basic header naming the logical unit and task, then type-specific fields and optional data. → [§B.3](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b3-upiu-the-ufs-packet)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### UFS Transport Protocol (UTP) { #term-ufs-transport-protocol-utp .sdd-term }

**UFS傳輸協議層（台：UFS傳輸協定層）** — The layer that wraps commands, data and responses into UPIUs. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### uncorrectable ECC error (UECC) { #term-uncorrectable-ecc-error-uecc .sdd-term }

**不可糾正ECC錯誤（台：無法更正的ECC錯誤）** — A read that every rung of the escalation ladder failed to correct; it is the event UBER counts. → [§A.7](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a7-the-ldpc-codec-inside-the-ssd)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### unified / normalized (design) { #term-unified-normalized-design .sdd-term }

**歸一化** — One controller design serving both enterprise and consumer drives, with the firmware making the difference. → [§2.4](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#24-case-study-one-controller-for-enterprise-and-consumer)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### UniPro { #term-unipro .sdd-term }

**UniPro統一協議（台：UniPro統一協定）** — UFS's link layer: reliable delivery with flow control and retransmission. → [§B.2](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b2-the-ufs-protocol-stack)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Universal Flash Storage (UFS) { #term-universal-flash-storage-ufs .sdd-term }

**通用閃存存儲（台：通用快閃儲存）** — JEDEC's storage standard for phones and other mobile devices: managed NAND speaking SCSI over a MIPI serial link. → [§B.1](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b1-what-ufs-is-the-emmc-successor)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### UNMAP { #term-unmap .sdd-term }

the SCSI / UFS equivalent of Trim  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### UPS { #term-ups .sdd-term }

uninterruptible power supply  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### upscreening { #term-upscreening .sdd-term }

testing/qualifying commercial parts for space use  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### upstream / downstream port { #term-upstream-downstream-port .sdd-term }

**上游 / 下游端口（台：上游 / 下游埠）** — A port facing toward the Root Complex, versus one facing away from it. → [§5.2](../core/ch5-pcie.md#52-topology-the-tree)  
<small>From: [Ch 5 — PCIe](../core/ch5-pcie.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### USB { #term-usb .sdd-term }

Universal Serial Bus  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### user space / kernel space { #term-user-space-kernel-space .sdd-term }

**用戶態 / 內核態（台：使用者空間 / 核心空間）** — Where ordinary programs run versus where the operating-system kernel runs; XtremIO runs in user space. → [§2.6.3](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#263-software-architecture-the-real-value)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## V { #letter-v }

### VAAI { #term-vaai .sdd-term }

vStorage APIs for Array Integration (VMware)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### valid data / invalid (garbage) data { #term-valid-data-invalid-garbage-data .sdd-term }

**有效數據 / 無效(垃圾)數據（台：有效資料 / 無效(垃圾)資料）** — Pages still mapped to an LBA, versus stale copies that only wait to be erased. → [§4.3.1](../core/ch4-ftl.md#431-the-gc-principle-via-a-toy-ssd)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### valid-page count (VPC) { #term-valid-page-count-vpc .sdd-term }

**有效頁數** — A per-block count of valid pages that lets GC find the cheapest victim at once. → [§4.3.3](../core/ch4-ftl.md#433-gc-implementation-three-steps)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Van Allen belts { #term-van-allen-belts .sdd-term }

Earth's trapped-radiation regions  
<small>From: [Supp E — Aerospace Storage](../supplements/e-aerospace-storage.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### variable node (VN) { #term-variable-node-vn .sdd-term }

**變量節點（台：變數節點）** — A Tanner-graph node for one codeword bit. → [§A.4.2](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#a42-the-tanner-graph)  
<small>From: [Supp A — ECC Coding Theory](../supplements/a-ecc-coding-theory.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### VDI { #term-vdi .sdd-term }

virtual desktop infrastructure  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### verification / validation { #term-verification-validation .sdd-term }

**驗證 / 確認** — Testing the design before the chip exists, versus testing the real silicon afterwards. → [§7.2](../core/ch7-testing.md#72-verification-vs-validation)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### VFS { #term-vfs .sdd-term }

Virtual File System (uniform kernel API above all filesystems)  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### VM { #term-vm .sdd-term }

virtual machine  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

## W { #letter-w }

### WAF { #term-waf .sdd-term }

write amplification factor  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### wandering tree { #term-wandering-tree .sdd-term }

LFS cascade of pointer updates; solved by NAT  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### WCTEMP { #term-wctemp .sdd-term }

Warning Composite Temperature Threshold (NVMe)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### WDPC { #term-wdpc .sdd-term }

workload-dependent preconditioning (SNIA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### wear leveling { #term-wear-leveling .sdd-term }

**磨損平衡（台：平均抹寫）** — Spreading erases evenly over all blocks so that none wears out early. → [§1.4](../core/ch1-overview.md#14-how-an-ssd-actually-works); Spreading erases evenly over all blocks so that none wears out early. → [§3.3.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#332-endurance-the-physics-of-wearing-out); Keeping erase counts even: dynamic wear leveling sends hot data to young blocks, static moves cold data onto old ones. → [§4.5](../core/ch4-ftl.md#45-wear-leveling)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Well-Known LU { #term-well-known-lu .sdd-term }

**知名邏輯單元** — A logical unit with a fixed role: Boot, RPMB, Device or Report LUNs. → [§B.4](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b4-logical-units)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### WIPC { #term-wipc .sdd-term }

workload-independent preconditioning (SNIA)  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### WL { #term-wl .sdd-term }

wear leveling  
<small>From: the site-wide acronym list</small>

### wordline / bitline { #term-wordline-bitline .sdd-term }

**字線 / 位線（台：字元線 / 位元線）** — The rows that select a page of cells and the columns along which each cell is sensed. → [§3.1.3](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#313-the-hierarchy-cell-page-block-plane-die)  
<small>From: [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### write amplification (WA) { #term-write-amplification-wa .sdd-term }

**寫放大（台：寫入放大）** — Bytes the drive writes to flash divided by bytes the host asked it to write; garbage collection pushes it above 1. → [§1.5.3](../core/ch1-overview.md#153-endurance); Bytes written to flash divided by bytes the host wrote; lowering it slows wear. → [§3.3.2](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#332-endurance-the-physics-of-wearing-out); Data written to flash divided by data the host wrote; GC, wear leveling and refreshes push it above 1. → [§4.3.2](../core/ch4-ftl.md#432-write-amplification)  
<small>From: [Ch 1 — SSD Overview](../core/ch1-overview.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 3 — NAND Flash](../core/ch3-nand-flash.md#key-vocabulary) · [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### write buffer / buffer { #term-write-buffer-buffer .sdd-term }

**寫緩存 / 緩衝（台：寫入快取 / 緩衝區）** — RAM where incoming write data waits before it is programmed into flash. → [§2.1.1](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#211-front-end)  
<small>From: [Ch 2 — Controllers & AFA](../core/ch2-controllers-afa.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### write saturation test { #term-write-saturation-test .sdd-term }

**飽和寫測試（台：飽和寫入測試）** — Sustained random writes for days, to watch performance degrade and settle. → [§7.10](../core/ch7-testing.md#710-performance-testing-the-snia-methodology)  
<small>From: [Ch 7 — SSD Testing](../core/ch7-testing.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### WriteBooster { #term-writebooster .sdd-term }

**寫入加速（WriteBooster）** — UFS's host-configurable SLC cache: part of the TLC or QLC array run as a fast write buffer. → [§B.7](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b7-writebooster)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

## Z { #letter-z }

### zone / write pointer { #term-zone-write-pointer .sdd-term }

**區域 / 寫指針（台：區域 / 寫入指標）** — A ZNS region that must be written sequentially, and the position where its next write must land. → [§6.10.1](../core/ch6-nvme.md#6101-zns-mechanics-zones-states-and-zone-append)  
<small>From: [Ch 6 — NVMe](../core/ch6-nvme.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Zoned Namespaces (ZNS) { #term-zoned-namespaces-zns .sdd-term }

**分區命名空間** — NVMe zones that must be written sequentially and reset as a whole, moving placement and GC to the host. → [§4.11](../core/ch4-ftl.md#zns-zoned-namespaces-nvme-20)  
<small>From: [Ch 4 — FTL](../core/ch4-ftl.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### Zoned UFS (ZUFS) { #term-zoned-ufs-zufs .sdd-term }

**分區UFS** — UFS 4.1's zoned storage, ZNS for mobile: host and device cooperate on data placement. → [§B.9](../supplements/b-ufs.md#b9-modern-developments-ufs-41-and-50)  
<small>From: [Supp B — UFS](../supplements/b-ufs.md#key-vocabulary)</small>

### ZUFS / zoned F2FS { #term-zufs-zoned-f2fs .sdd-term }

F2FS on a zoned device (ZNS/ZUFS) — collapses the double log  
<small>From: [Supp C — Flash File Systems](../supplements/c-flash-file-systems.md#key-vocabulary)</small>
